summary: Implemented stdlib-only fail-closed Minis GPT -> official Gemini Pro web agent -> GitHub -> GPT bridge CLI (validate, submit, status, collect), mocked unit test suite, concise Chinese operating manual, and example contract.
runtime_unverified_limitations: Local Minis executables (minis-browser-use and minis-mcp-cli) are not present in the cloud sandbox; all subprocess interactions were verified only via unit test mocks.

Live Antigravity web UI DOM selectors (editor, model selector, project header, send/stop buttons, assistant/user message containers, and error banners) have not been executed against a live Minis browser session.
Real GitHub MCP tool argument names and response envelopes on the target iOS Minis Alpine aarch64 host have not been exercised end-to-end.
Human sign-in/verification handling, Pro quota behavior, and iOS app suspension/resume behavior require independent verification on Minis by GPT.
